name: Harbor
description: The services of a project's harbor.yaml as launches, and a shell in one of them, opened from the menu of a new terminal or with its first command typed.

permissions.canvas.write: Opens a terminal for a shell in a service
permissions.files.read: Reads harbor.yaml in the project folder
permissions.launches.provide: Lists the services of harbor.yaml as launches
permissions.launches.read: Shows which of its services run
permissions.terminals.profiles: Adds a shell in a service to the menu of a new terminal
permissions.terminals.read: Shows the last line of the terminal you select
permissions.terminals.write: Types the first command into a shell it opened
